title: Why Manaveeyam Veedhi is at the centre of a political battle between BJP, CPI(M) in Keralam capital

ai.summary: Manaveeyam Veedhi, a cultural corridor in Thiruvananthapuram, is at the center of a political dispute between the BJP and CPI(M) over its management and use as a protest space.

facts.claim: Manaveeyam Veedhi is a cultural corridor in Thiruvananthapuram
facts.quote: Manaveeyam Veedhi, the cultural corridor of Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam, is now caught in a political battle between the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Communist Party of India (Marxist).

facts.claim: The BJP took power in the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation in local body elections last December
facts.quote: The BJP, which took power in the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation in the local body elections last December, is attempting to bring about certain changes on the street, which has been hosting various cultural events as well as protest programmes for the past three decades.

facts.claim: The Museum Police attempted to seize a microphone ahead of a protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
facts.quote: The simmering issues came out into the open on October 16 when the Museum Police attempted to seize a microphone ahead of a protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

facts.claim: CPI(M) leader V.Sivankutty said the denial of police permission for the event featuring actor-activist Prakash Raj was prompted by instructions from the Corporation authorities
facts.quote: According to CPI(M) leader and former Thiruvananthapuram Mayor V.Sivankutty, the denial of police permission for the event featuring actor-activist Prakash Raj was prompted by instructions from the Corporation authorities.

facts.claim: The BJP-led Corporation wants to make Manaveeyam Veedhi 'protest-free'
facts.quote: Last week, the BJP-led Corporation made clear its intent to make the street “protest-free” and to keep it limited to cultural activities, leading to protests by cultural activists who have been part of the street’s activities for a long time.

facts.claim: K.G. Suraj, secretary of the Manaveeyam Theruvidam Cultural Collective and Street Library, calls the move a blatant overreach of authority
facts.quote: K.G. Suraj, secretary of the Manaveeyam Theruvidam Cultural Collective and Street Library, calls the move a blatant overreach of authority.

facts.claim: Manaveeyam Veedhi was constructed and renovated by the State government with coordination of various government departments
facts.quote: Manaveeyam Veedhi was constructed and subsequently renovated by the State government with the coordination of various government departments.

facts.claim: The Thiruvananthapuram Corporation does not have regulatory control over Manaveeyam Veedhi
facts.quote: Any claim by the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation to have regulatory control over Manaveeyam Veedhi is purely illusory.

facts.claim: Manaveeyam Veedhi is a road under the Public Works department (PWD) and its management rights have never been transferred to the Municipal Corporation
facts.quote: According to Mr. Sivankutty, Manaveeyam Veedhi is a road under the Public Works department (PWD) and that its management rights have never been transferred to the Municipal Corporation.

facts.claim: Congress councillor K.S. Sabarinadhan said the Corporation must preserve Manaveeyam as a space that upholds all democratic rights
facts.quote: Congress councillor K.S. Sabarinadhan said that the Corporation must adopt a position that preserves Manaveeyam as a space that upholds all democratic rights.

ai.background_note: The political dispute over Manaveeyam Veedhi involves the BJP and CPI(M) over its management and use as a protest space, with the BJP-led Corporation attempting to make it 'protest-free' after previously hosting cultural events and protests.
